Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Punchline: Automatically price new and existing retainer listings.
Description: Automatically price eligible inventory and reprice existing listings one gil below matching competition using Universalis market prices and recent sale history.
Changelog: Skips spiritbound gear during automatic market listings, fixes Auto vendor menu selection and continues past an already-open shop item menu, and adds /retainer as a shortcut. Also includes safer Auto update dialogue handling, support for stacks above 99, editable price-drop review bands, and Sniper value filtering with sortable server/listing columns.
